fields.sentence: Whenever a funeral takes place, a Keeper repeats the phrase.

fields.sentence: Whenever the Council closes a session, a Keeper repeats the phrase.
parse: (: lorep19_whenever_rule (Implication (And (Member $x close) (Agent $x sk_council_1) (Patient $x $s) (Member $s session)) (And (Member (sk_repeat $x) repeat) (Agent (sk_repeat $x) (sk_keeper $x)) (Member (sk_keeper $x) keeper) (Theme (sk_repeat $x) sk_phrase_1) (During (sk_repeat $x) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Whenever-rule shape, During link, no QuantifierPhrase, definite "the phrase" projected top-level and the indefinite "a Keeper" as a per-occurrence Skolem function all match the instruction set; "the Council" correctly takes the capitalized-common-noun default (no Name).
